posts.title: A Horror Gem Is Getting A Sequel
posts.description: The 2007 “psychological supernatural horror” movie, 1408, was based on a short story by Stephen King. With a great cast, solid reviews, and a lucrative box office, a sequel seemed inevitable, if long in coming. My question is, to which of the film’s multiple endings will the sequel connect? The post A Horror Gem Is Getting A Sequel appeared first on Mike Sirota .

posts.title: November…Remember
posts.description: Most of you adults out there can recall in detail where you were and what you were doing on September 11th, 2001, the date of the terrorist attacks. That seems to be the way it is on memorable—if tragic—days in our country’s history. But you would have to be up in my age range to recall the events on another dark day: November 22nd, 1963. The post November…Remember appeared first on Mike Sirota .

posts.title: A Remake Of A Classic—Over 70 Years Later?
posts.description: I grew up with the 1954 “Big Bug” monster movie, THEM! (Their exclamation point.) It is one of my all-time favorites in any genre, and I have long since run out of fingers and toes to count how many times I’ve watched it. There have been other movies featuring giant ants, but no remake of Them! Until now. Maybe… The post A Remake Of A Classic—Over 70 Years Later? appeared first on Mike Sirota .
